scope: Exact first residual type-5 point from the geometry-only physics probe. Forced-coordinate diagnostic in isolated copy; no production events or integration estimate.
root_cause: sborncol_fsr used the legacy external dot, which snaps |p.q|<1e-6 to zero. In a boosted local dipole this erases a resolved positive quark energy. Its AP variable t=z*Q^2/4 vanishes and the local collinear counterterm becomes nonfinite. Separately, forming z by subtracting the gluon fraction from 1 loses smaller positive fractions even with a nonzero quark energy.
fix: Use the unrounded fks_phase_space_helpers dot in sborncol_fsr.
Compute z=E_j/(E_i+E_j) instead of 1-E_i/(E_i+E_j). Both are algebraically equivalent in exact arithmetic.
validation: test_fsr_collinear_stability.py: actual sborncol_fsr, AP and Q-term routines with a unit Born stub; captured dipole and daughter vectors, 1e-6 and 1e-12 daughter rescalings, positive fractions down to 1e-100, and ordinary kernels. All 3 tests passed with floating invalid/zero/overflow traps enabled.
